about: The live take: the command spoken, and a change to the plan said into the microphone while both arms work, transcribed live by Speechmatics. Fixed before recording, like configs/demo_seeds.json; a held-out seed, not tuned on. Up to three takes are recorded and the best is kept; the video says which take it is. The statistics are the 100 held-out tables, not this take.

seeds.say_when: after the terminal shows skill_start for the spoon
